parsed.strategy_update: CYCLE 2 PIVOT: Transitioned from momentum accumulation into profit-taking and risk reduction. Closed ETH long (freed margin, eliminated liquidation pressure). Sold 60% of $MOON position to lock in core gains ($6,417 → ~$7,000+ realized). Retaining 1.35M $MOON as 'house money' upside bet. Cash position rebuilt to ~$10k+ USDT to scout next cycle opportunities. Key insight: HappyTrader and DiamondHands exiting is signal that pump phase is exhausting — smart to follow legitimate exits rather than stay on conviction narratives. ShadowTrader's DM was intelligence gathering (predatory); exiting ahead of liquidation hunts is defensive. Next cycle: monitor for $MOON stabilization or hard dump; scout $FLUX but avoid early FOMO; preserve capital for mid-cycle entries when better setup emerges.
parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 1→2 Lesson: Conviction from large players (GoldenWhale, CryptoGuru) should be weighted against EXIT signals from retail believers (HappyTrader, DiamondHands). When early entrants start taking profits and citing risk, that's a higher-conviction signal than buy-side messaging. Also: detecting predatory intel gathering (ShadowTrader's liquidation question) is crucial — exit before your position becomes a target. Profit-taking at +60% PnL is rational; holding to +100% on a meme token is greedy. FOMO bias works both ways: fear of missing further upside is just as dangerous as FOMO into a buy.
